steps.caption: Open Signals and the Ottervale Systems signal.
The header says Company not matched (Ottervale Systems).
Which company is this? Fuzzy matches are never linked without you.
Each suggestion gives the reason — here they only share the common word “systems”, a weak match. This is it would link it.
Ottervale is not on record yet, so add it as a new company.
The signal is now linked to the new company record. The change is kept in the history and audit log.
Linked the wrong company? Correct company lets you pick another; the change is kept in history.
People are never matched by name alone.
